classification.difficultyReason: Count shaded and total equal regions in the supplied paired models and write the corresponding equivalent fractions; subdivisions are already drawn.

spec.description: Equal upright rectangular models side by side, separated by an equals sign.
spec.mathematics: Three of four horizontal strips and nine of twelve cells are shaded; both represent three quarters.
spec.answerVisibility: The shaded models are permanent givens; the missing numerator is not printed.

answer.worked:
Splitting each of the $4$ strips into $3$ cells gives $12$ equal parts. The $3$ shaded strips become $9$ shaded cells.
$$\frac34=\frac9{12}$$

spec.description: Equal rectangular models side by side, separated by an equals sign.
spec.mathematics: Three of five horizontal strips are selected in the first model. Nine of fifteen cells are selected in the second.
spec.answerVisibility: Both shaded models are permanent givens. The first denominator and second numerator remain blank.

answer.worked:
The first whole has $5$ equal strips, with $3$ shaded. Splitting each strip into three gives $15$ equal parts, with $9$ shaded.
$$\frac{3}{5}=\frac{9}{15}$$

spec.description: Equal circles side by side, separated by an equals sign. Their right halves are selected.
spec.mathematics: The first circle has one of two equal halves selected. The second has four of eight equal sectors selected.
spec.answerVisibility: The models are permanent givens; all four fraction entries remain blank.

answer.worked:
The first circle has $1$ of its $2$ equal parts shaded. The same half contains $4$ of the second circle's $8$ equal sectors.
$$\frac{1}{2}=\frac{4}{8}$$

spec.description: Equal upright regular pentagons side by side, separated by an equals sign. Corresponding left and bottom regions are selected.
spec.mathematics: Centre-to-vertex divisions form five equal-area triangles. Three are selected. Centre-to-side-midpoint divisions bisect each triangle in the second model, giving six selected regions out of ten.
spec.answerVisibility: All model subdivisions and selected regions are permanent givens; all four fraction entries remain blank.

answer.worked:
The first pentagon has $3$ of its $5$ equal regions shaded. Splitting each region into two gives $10$ equal regions, with $6$ shaded.
$$\frac{3}{5}=\frac{6}{10}$$
